title: TRAPPIST-1b and c at 15 µm: the ten MIRI/F1500W visits of Bell's joint fit, with b's phase curve held symmetric
settingsSource: Bell's Stage 5 control and parameter files, deposited with Gillon, Ducrot et al. (2025) at doi:10.5281/zenodo.17710453 (Bell_FinalECFs), translated to Eureka! 1.4's parameter names (planet suffixes _pl1/_pl2, visit suffixes _chN, quasi_gamma). b's phase curve is Eureka!'s sinusoid with its sine amplitude held at 0; c keeps Bell's quasi-Lambertian curve. Least squares only.
